title: 30 MINUTES MOST POWERFUL PSALM 120 MORNING PRAYER TO START YOUR DAY
text: Beloved, hear me. Every morning is a doorway into destiny, a gate into the unfolding of prophecy. How you start your day matters greatly in the realm of the spirit. Psalm 120:1 declares, "In my distress, I cried unto the Lord and he heard me." This morning before you step into the battles, the meetings, the challenges, and the opportunities that await, we stand on the authority of scripture to cry onto the Lord, to decree into the day, to command the morning, and to legislate victories in the realm of the spirit. There are three things that happen when you engage the morning in prayer. You set the atmosphere for divine favor. You silence the voice of the enemy. and you summon the help of God for the journey ahead. Job 38:12-13 says, "Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days, and caused the daypring to know his place, that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it." Prayer in the morning is a weapon of command. It takes hold of the hours and shakes out the wicked. I decree and declare this day shall favor you. The sun, the moon, and the stars will not fight against you. Every element of creation shall work for your good. Where your name is mentioned, let favor answer for you. Where a trap has been set for you, let it backfire in the name of Jesus. This morning, every voice of accusation raised against you in the spirit is silenced. Revelation 12:11 declares, "And they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony. I decree that the blood of Jesus speaks over your life this morning. The blood speaks mercy where judgment was planned. The blood speaks favor where rejection was waiting. The blood speaks life where death was programmed. Lift your hands wherever you are and declare after me this morning. I arise in victory. I clothe myself with the whole armor of God. I decree that no weapon fashioned against me shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against me in judgment is condemned. By the blood of Jesus, I am covered. By the mercy of God, I am preserved. By the I cried unto the Lord in my distress and he heard me. I cried unto the Lord in my distress and he answered me. [Music] Deliver my soul, oh Lord, from lying lips, from deceitful tongues. You are my refuge. You are my shield. You hear the cry of the righteous in the night. Answer me, oh Lord, in my day of trouble. Answer me, oh Lord. Let fire fall. Let mercy speak in the name of Jesus. May your cry ascend to the throne. May your prayer become incense before the God who hears. Woe is me. I dwell among strangers. But you, oh Lord, are my peace. You surround me with your mercy. You cover me with your love raand zouch. Thank you Jesus. This morning we press deeper. Psalm 120:2 declares, "Deliver my soul, oh Lord, from lying lips and from a deceitful tongue." That means God knows there are voices and altars that rise early to misrepresent you, to accuse you, to speak words into your day. But hear me beloved, every lying leap is silenced by the voice of the Lord this morning. Every evil tongue is cut off by the word of God. Isaiah 54:17 says, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn." I decree and declare, every voice speaking against your destiny this morning is condemned. Whether it is in your workplace, in your family, in the courts of men, or in the courts of spirit, let their voices be silenced now in the name of Jesus. By the authority of the word, I cancel negative decrees. I revoke satanic verdicts. I erase demonic signatures placed against your name. The voice of the blood of Jesus speaks louder and it prevails. We now turn our prayer against stagnation. Psalm 30:5 says, "Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning. I decree over you, no more cycles of delay, no more repeated seasons of failure. Every demonic calendar that programs setbacks into your life is destroyed by fire. by the mercies of God. This morning marks the beginning of a new cycle of advancement. You will go forward. You will rise higher. You will move from where you are to where God has destined you over your destiny. Helpers, I decree alignment. Genesis 41 shows that Joseph was remembered in the morning and called out of the prison. I prophesy this morning. Your name is remembered for lifting. Helpers that forgot you will call you. Systems that ignored you will recognize you by the decree of heaven. The anointing for remembrance comes upon you. Now we also legislate over your family. Psalm 127:3 says, "Lo, children are an heritage of the Lord and the fruit of the womb is his reward. I decree and declare your family will not be mocked. Any household altar that fights marriages over your workplace and career, I declare enlargement. Psalm 9:17 says, "And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us, and establish thou the work of our hands upon us. Yay, the work of our hands establish thou it. Your effort today will not be wasted. Your labor will not end in vain. Every demonic opposition against your project is destroyed. Receive favor before clients, before employers, before leaders. May the work of your hands bring increase. Now we confront witchcraft manipulation. Micah 5:12 says, "And I will cut off witchcraft out of thine hand, and thou shalt have no more soothsayers." I decree and declare, every witchcraft network against your destiny collapses this morning. Every spell projected into your dreams, into your morning atmosphere is destroyed. every altar of divination, every satanic mirror, every evil port calling your name be destroyed in the name of Jesus. I return every arrow back to the sender. Let fire fall upon every evil gathering against you. Let confusion scatter their camp. Hear me. Someone under the sound of my voice, thus saith the spirit of God. You have been under monitoring spirits. Eyes that follow you to frustrate your progress. But this morning, their eyes are blinded. Their instruments are destroyed. Their powers are rendered useless. Receive your liberty in the name of Jesus. Now we raise a sound of worship. Lord, you are the one who rules over the day and the night. You are the one who breaks the staff of the wicked. You are the one who prepares a table before us in the presence of our enemies. We enthrone you as king over this morning. Lift your hands wherever you are and make these decrees. I decree my path is shining brighter and brighter. I decree I am preserved from evil. I decree I am a candidate of favor today. I decree my feet will not walk into destruction. I decree my hands will not gather sorrow. I decree my head is lifted like the horn of a unicorn. I decree my mouth shall testify of the goodness of God. Beloved, let us press into the third dimension of this prophetic ministration. Psalm 12:3-4 says, "What shall be given unto thee or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue? Sharp arrows of the mighty with coals of juniper." This morning in the spirit, God equips his people with sharp arrows and coals of fire, to answer every false tongue, to judge every wickedness, and to scatter every altar of darkness. You will not leave this session the same. Strongholds are being shattered and chains are being broken. I decree and declare every stronghold of the enemy in your life comes down now. 2 Corinthians 10:4 says, "For the weapons of our warfare are not cannal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds." Every stronghold of poverty be broken. Every stronghold of delay collapse. Every stronghold of fear and confusion shatter in the name of Jesus. We now contend with household altars. Judges 6:25-26 shows Gideon commanded to tear down his father's altar and raise another for the Lord. I decree and declare every altar in your lineage speaking against your progress is destroyed. Ancestral altars that tie men to failure scatter by fire. Family covenants that resist advancement be broken by the blood of Jesus. Altars of untimely death hear the word of the Lord. You will not prosper. Evil sacrifices made in your name are reversed. This morning I raise an altar of the blood of Jesus in your family. By that blood, let generational curses be replaced with generational blessings over your destiny. I release divine speed. First Kings 18:46 says, "And the hand of the Lord was on Elijah, and he gathered up his loins and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezrael. May the hand of God come upon you for acceleration. What should take 10 years, let grace accomplish in one year. What men said was impossible, let the God of speed make possible, I decree, run ahead of those who mocked you, run ahead of those who despised you, over over your health. I declare total restoration. Psalm 107:20 says, "He sent his word and healed them and delivered them from their destructions. I send the word of God into your body. Be healed." I decree restoration of sight, restoration of hearing, restoration of strength, restoration of organs, restoration of bones, restoration of blood. Any sickness planted in your body is uprooted. Any agenda of hell to afflict you with disease is reversed. You shall enjoy divine health in the name of Jesus. Now hear the word of the Lord. Every evil arrow fired against you returns to sender. Psalm 64:7 says, "But God shall shoot at them with an arrow. Suddenly shall they be wounded. I decree arrows of shame go back to sender. Arrows of poverty return to sender. Arrows of delay and disappointment return to sender. Arrows of confusion, depression, and death go back to sender. Let sudden judgment come upon every enemy that refuses to repent over your family. I decree protection. Psalm 91:11 says, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. Angels are stationed around your children. Angels guard your spouse. Angels encamp around your home. No evil shall touch you. No accident shall come near you. No tragedy shall happen in your household. Now I declare militant warfare against witchcraft operations. Exodus 22:18 says, "Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live. Every power of witchcraft manipulating your destiny be destroyed. Every enchantment, spell, or incantation against you, break now. Every gathering of witches and wizards against your rising, scatter by fire. By the blood of Jesus, I overturn their operations. By the name of Jesus, I nullify their sacrifices. By the spirit of God, I dismantle their networks. Thus, sayeth the spirit of the Lord. Someone listening, your dreams have been filled with battles, with snakes, with evil presences. Tonight that affliction ends. I set you free. You will dream dreams of victory and breakthrough. No more harassment in your sleep. Another your beloved as you step into the fullness of this day. Let these words accompany you. Isaiah 61. Arise, shine, for thy light is come and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee. this morning. Arise, shine, walk in glory, walk in victory, walk in prosperity, walk in health, walk in favor. As I close this third part of our prophetic ministration, I seal your destiny with the blood of Jesus. I decree no reversal of your breakthroughs. I decree no manipulation of your testimony. I decree no delay of your answers this morning. You walk under an open heaven. Your testimony is sure. Your victory is permanent in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen. And amen. Beloved, as we advance into this fourth part of this prophetic ministration, the spirit of God is drawing us into deeper waters of warfare and deliverance. Psalm 126:7 says, "My soul had long dwelt with him that hated peace. I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war. There are adversaries who will never rest until they see your downfall. But by the blood of Jesus, you shall not be defeated. By the authority of the word, every war against your destiny is silenced tonight in the name of Jesus. I decree and declare every satanic conspiracy against your rising collapses. Job 5:12 says, "He disappointed the devices of the crafty so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise. I frustrate every plan of the wicked over your life. Let their devices backfire. Let their schemes be exposed. Let their networks scatter. Beloved, lift your voice and begin to renounce every agreement with darkness. Deuteronomy 7:5 says, "But thus shall ye deal with them. Ye shall destroy their altars and break down their images and cut down their groves and burn their graven images with fire. Every altar raised against you be destroyed by fire. Every image used to represent you in the kingdom of darkness born by the fire of God. Every covenant entered on your behalf without your consent. I cancel by the blood of Jesus. Every dedication of your name, lift your right hand and declare after me. By the blood of Jesus, I am untouchable. >> By the blood of Jesus, I am unstoppable. By the blood of Jesus, I am unmovable. By the blood of Jesus, I am preserved over your household. I decree preservation. Isaiah 49:25 says, "Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered. For I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children. I speak deliverance over your sons, deliverance over your daughters. I decree no evil hand will touch them. No strange sickness will afflict them. No arrow of the wicked will locate them. Over your career and business I release divine favor. Psalm 5:12 says, "For thou, Lord will bless the righteous. With favor will thou compass him as with a shield. I decree contracts are released, partnerships are established, promotion is granted, delays are broken, favors locate you. Where you have been rejected, may they call you back with honor. Where you have been despised, may they now celebrate you. Hear me. Jeremiah 3:16 says, "Therefore, all they that devour thee shall be devoured, and all thine adversaries, every one of them shall go into captivity, and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that pray upon thee will I give for a prey. Every adversary that refuse to let you go is devoured. Every power spoiling your blessings is spoiled. Every enemy praying on your destiny becomes prey. Lift your voice and begin to declare. I decree and declare. Every chain over my finances, break now. Every curse over my health, break now. Every covenant over my marriage, break now. Every spell against my rising, break now. Every word spoken against my progress, nullify now. Worship him Lord. You are the consuming fire. You are the judge of the nations. You are the man of war. We exalt you. We glorify you. You reign forever. Beloved, as we close this dimension of prayer, I seal you under the blood. Revelation 12:11 says, "And they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their." Beloved, hear me as I speak by the spirit of God. Every new day is an opportunity for alignment, for victory, and for divine preservation. The Bible declares in Psalm 120:1, "In my distress, I cried unto the Lord, and he heard me." That is a covenant assurance that no matter the weight of yesterday, no matter the arrows fired at night, when you lift your cry in the morning to the God of heaven, he hears. You are not waking up into an uncertain day. You are waking up into a day that is commanded by prayer, a day programmed by the decrees of the word. Hear this truth. Mornings are gateways. Job 38:12 asks, "Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days, and caused the daypring to know his place? If you do not command the morning, others will. If you do not speak into your day, evil voices will. But this morning, under the authority of the blood of Jesus, we silence every contrary voice. We arrest every demonic programming. will overturn every evil expectation. I decree and declare over your life by the power of the blood of Jesus, no arrow of the wicked shall prosper against you today. Psalm 91:5-6 declares, "Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flyth by day, nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor for the destruction that wasteth at noon day. This day arrows are reversed. This day pestilence is silenced. This day destruction is scattered. Thus sayeth the spirit of God, someone under the sound of my voice has been wakened with heaviness. A sense of oppression every morning as though chains are waiting at the gate of your day. But the Lord says, "This morning I break the yoke. This morning I lift the burden. This morning I release you into liberty. Isaiah 10:27 declares, "And the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing. Let every yoke of heaviness be destroyed. Let every morning oppression be broken. Now rise in prayer and decree with fire. I decree and declare this morning is sanctified. Every hour ahead is preserved. I command the sun, the moon, and I speak over your finances this morning. Deuteronomy 28:11-12 declares, "And the Lord shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the Lord swear unto thy fathers to give thee. The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season. Every financial struggle that followed you into this day, I break it. Every curse of emptiness scatter. Every devourer be rebuked. Step into abundance. Step into increase. Step into overflow. I speak over your health. Psalm 103:es 3-4 declares, "Who forgiveth all thy iniquities? Who healthth all thy diseases? Who redeemth thy life from destruction? Who crowneth thee with loving kindness and tender messes? Every sickness waiting for you today, I cancel it. Every arrow of affliction fired against your body, backfire. You will not collapse. You will not be sick. You will not die. The Lord redeems your life from destruction. Lift your voice again. I decree and declare. My morning is blessed. My steps are ordered. My path is preserved. My destiny is advanced. My hands are fruitful. My family is secured. No altar shall prevail. No cause shall stand. No arrow shall prosper. This is my day of testimony. Beloved, worship him now. Psalm 92:1-2 declares, "It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord, and to sing praises unto thy name, oh most high, to show forth thy loving kindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night." Lift a sound of gratitude. Thank him for life. Thank him for preservation. Thank him for turning captivity into liberty. Father, we magnify you as the God of our mornings. You are the light that shines in darkness. You are the keeper of Israel who neither slumbers nor sleeps. We enthron you over this day. We enthrone you over our families. We enthrone you over our finances, our health, and our destiny. And now I seal these decrees with the eternal blood of I decree and declare by the authority of the word every evil pronouncement made over this day concerning you is nullified. Isaiah 54:17 says, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn. Every tongue that spoke failure against your business, I silence it. Every voice that whispered sickness into your health, I shut it down. Every tongue that decreed shame against your family, I condemn it now." Thus sayeth the spirit of God, someone under the sound of my voice, you have been waking up to news of disappointment, rejection, and delay. But the Lord says, "This morning, I am turning the tide. You will wake to good news. You will wake to favor. You will wake to victory." Psalm 112:4 declares, "Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness. He is gracious and full of compassion and righteous. Light arises for you this morning. Lift your voice with holy boldness and decree. I decree and declare every satanic program written against me today be erased by the blood of Jesus. Every plot of accident scatter. Every appointment with tragedy cancel. Every demonic arrangement to waste my resources fail today. My eyes will see good. My ears will hear good. My hands will touch good. My tongue will testify of good. I prophesy over your destiny this morning. Psalm 121 7-8 says, "The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil. He shall preserve thy soul." The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth and even forever more. As you go out today, you are preserved. As you return, you are preserved. Preservation from accidents, preservation from arrows, preservation from conspiracies. I prophesy over your finances. Hagai 2:8 declares, "The silver is mine and the gold is mine, sayaeth the Lord of hosts. Every scarcity in your life ends this morning. Every devourer eating your harvest be judged. Every embargo on your advancement scatter. May your word, beloved, worship him." Psalm 59:16 says, "But I will sing of thy power. Yay, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning." Worship him because his mercy has spoken for you. Worship him because his power has gone ahead of you. Worship him because his presence crowns your mourning with peace. Father, we exalt you as the God of our mournings. The God who turns sorrow into joy. The God who crowns our day with goodness. We enthrone you above the sun, the moon, and the elements. Let everything you created cooperate with our destiny today. And now I seal these decrees with the blood of Jesus. This day will not betray you. This day will not waste you. This day will not end in shame. Instead, it will deliver testimonies, breakthroughs, and undeniable victories in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Amen. And amen. Beloved, hear me clearly. The morning is not just the beginning of a new day. It is a spiritual gate. Whoever controls the morning controls the day. That is why lamentations 3:22-23 says, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." Every morning comes with fresh mercy, fresh opportunities, fresh favor. This is why the enemy also fights mornings with evil decrees, arrows, and satanic programming. But this morning, your gate is secured in Christ. Thus saith the spirit of God. There are some of you every morning you wake up with strange heaviness. Some you wake up tired, drained, and spiritually weak because the enemy labored through the night. But the Lord declares, "I give my beloved sleep." Psalm 127:2, "From this moment, your mornings will no longer be manipulated. Every demonic labor of the night is cancelled. Every satanic planting is uprooted. Every arrow fired at night is returned to sender. Lift up your voice now and decree with violence. I decree and declare. Every morning enchantment against me scatter every voice of divination programmed into my day be silenced. I prophesy over your family. Isaiah 49:25 declares, "But thus saeth the Lord, even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered, for I will contend with him that contended with thee, and I will save thy children." Every family contention ends this morning. Every satanic voice crying against your marriage, be silenced. Every demonic chain binding your children, be broken. The God of Israel saves your household today. I prophesy over your health. Malachi 4:2 says, "But unto you that fear my name shall the son of righteousness arise with healing in his wings. As the morning sun rises, let healing rise upon you. Let every affliction expire. Let every chronic sickness dissolve. Let every satanic arrow of infirmity be reversed. From the crown of your head to the soles of your feet, you are made whole. I prophesy over your finances. Psalm 68:19 says, "Blessed be the Lord who daily loaded us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Every benefit allocated for you today, I release it. Every breakthrough designed for you this morning, I command it to manifest. You will not labor in vain. You will not work for another to eat. The God of heaven will cause resources to answer to you speedily. Now lift your hands and decree. I decree and declare this morning is blessed. This day is blessed. My family is blessed. My destiny is blessed. My health is blessed. My finances are blessed. No altar shall stand against me. No cause shall prevail. No arrow shall prosper. Today I step into victory. I step into peace. I step into joy. I step into testimonies. Beloved, lift a song of worship. Psalm 92:1-2 declares, "It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord, and to sing praises unto thy name, oh most high, to show forth thy loving kindness in the morning and thy faithfulness every night. Worship him for he has secured your morning. Worship him for he has silenced your enemies. Worship him for he has filled your day with laughter.
